description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the Monitor plugin for a web-based system, including initialization, request processing, and cleanup functions.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: Main class implementing the monitoring plugin, handling initialization, request processing, and cleanup.

methods.name: Monitor::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the monitor plugin, sets up configuration, and registers monitoring components.

methods.name: Monitor::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters components during shutdown.

methods.name: Monitor::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently returns null.

methods.name: Monitor::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests, setting up request bodies for POST and PUT methods.

methods.name: Monitor::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests, handling GET, PUT, and POST to retrieve or reset memory measurements, or update monitoring parameters.
